summary_rationale: Alphabet Inc. earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS business quality verdict with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health on a strictly price-blind fundamental assessment. Over the past decade (FY2016–FY2025), Alphabet compounded revenue at an 18.1% CAGR ($90.3B to $402.8B) and GAAP operating income at a 20.7% CAGR ($23.7B to $129.0B), while crossing a $500B annualized revenue run rate in Q3 2026 ($127.6B quarterly revenue, +25% YoY). Its core moat rests on three reinforcing pillars: (1) Google Services ($342.7B FY2025 revenue, 40.7% operating margin), where AI Mode (>1B MAUs) and AI Overviews have sustained commercial Search monetization (+8% paid clicks and +4% CPC in Q3 2026) alongside 150M+ YouTube Music/Premium subscribers; (2) Google Cloud ($58.7B FY2025 -> $30.7B in Q3 2026, +103% YoY, 36.2% operating margin), anchored by a $561B RPO backlog and custom Ironwood TPU v7 silicon co-designed with Broadcom; and (3) a fortress balance sheet ($126.8B cash & marketable securities vs. $46.5B LT debt and $16.8B operating leases, 28.67% ROIC, and buybacks covering SBC 1.83x). KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than unblemished PASS due to two structural watch items: massive AI CapEx escalation ($91.4B in FY2025 -> $195B–$205B guided for FY2026, pushing Q3 2026 FCF to -$9.1B and creating a future depreciation wall) and ongoing DOJ antitrust appeals over default-search placement payments and mandatory search-index data sharing.
